About the Role
We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments team, focused on maximizing the impact of Claude in the life sciences. Our goal is ambitious: accelerate scientific progress from R&D through translation. That means making Claude the go-to tool for the life sciences ecosystem from early discovery in academia to paradigm shifting biotech to reimagining pharma pipelines - and building the technical infrastructure to back that up.
You'll work directly with flagship research partners like The Howard Hughes Medical Institute (HHMI) and The Allen Institute, embedded in their scientific workflows. This role will be part of the founding Beneficial Deployments Applied AI team focused on bringing life sciences closer to the frontier.

Partner deeply with flagship life sciences research institutions - understand their scientific workflows end-to-end, build hands-on with their engineering teams, and help take projects from early exploration to production systems integrated into how they do science day-to-day.

Identify what's actually hard about deploying AI in life sciences (heterogeneous data, auditability requirements, the prototype-to-trust gap) and feed those findings back to product, engineering, and research.

Deep research experience in life sciences, biomedical research, or scientific computing. Bonus if you've studied genomics, neuroscience, or drug discovery specifically and are comfortable getting deeply technical with academics.

Builder credibility from shipping production code as a software engineer, forward-deployed engineer, or technical founder.
A scrappy mentality–comfortable wearing multiple hats, building from scratch, driving clarity in ambiguous situations, and doing whatever it takes to further the mission.

The Kitchen
brings together a range of disciplines and capabilities. It’s a team of creatives, producers, data analysts and social experts working together to deliver remarkable ideas that live in a variety of mediums, from everything from social to TV. This team moves at the speed of culture. At The Kitchen, we're not just looking for individuals who want to be a part of the advertising industry - we're looking for trailblazers who are ready to lead the way to the next big thing! We want individuals who are passionate about producing award-winning work and have an innate drive to their craft and are eager to generate innovative ideas both within and outside of the brief.
ROLE OVERVIEW
As The Kitchen’s
Insights Analyst
, you’re an expert in social listening who can turn raw conversation data into clear, actionable insights. You run and maintain listening scans across brand, campaign, and newsroom topics and know how to translate volume, sentiment, themes, and emerging conversations into takeaways that matter: what’s happening, why it matters, and what we should be watching next.
Beyond listening scans, you look for patterns across culture, identifying spaces and moments where the brand has a right to win. You use those insights to help answer briefs shared by Strategy, working collaboratively to bring listening and cultural signals into the development of ideas.
You work closely with your manager, Strategy, and Creative to bring these signals into briefs and creative decisions. You bring your own curiosity and interests to the role, but at its core, your job is understanding data, converting it into actionable insights, and knowing how to distinguish what’s meaningful from what’s simply noise.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
SOCIAL LISTENING:
You keep your finger on the pulse of online conversation. You have experience with at least one social listening tool and understand how to measure sentiment, monitor conversation volume, identify themes, and track emerging topics. You run and maintain listening scans across brand, campaign, and newsroom needs, translating raw conversation data into clear, actionable insights for the broader team.
TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE:
You have experience in at least one major social media management or listening suite (i.e. Talkwalker, Sprout Social, Hootsuite, Buffer, etc.). You have an excellent understanding of the insights and reporting capabilities available within these programs and know how to apply them effectively to your work.
INNOVATION:
You’re aware of and constantly thinking about new ways to track and understand conversations online. You stay informed and at the leading edge of digital media, culture, and emerging social platforms.
COLLABORATION:
You work closely with Strategy and Creative to help shape ideas based on real conversation patterns and listening insights. This role goes beyond reporting data—you actively partner cross-functionally to bring insights into briefs and the creative process. You’re happy to analyze trends others bring to the table, aren’t precious or protective of your work, and are willing to work across functions to help others succeed.
BRIEF & STAKEHOLDER PARTNERSHIP:
You own and collaborate on the listening component of briefs, helping determine where social listening can provide meaningful answers and insights. You set clear expectations with the broader team around what our listening tools can and can’t support and help educate stakeholders on how to scope requests accordingly.
IDEATION:
You enjoy the creative process. You might not consider yourself a “creative” by role or title, but you enjoy being part of the ideation process and contributing ideas. You look for patterns across culture and identify spaces and moments where brands have a right to participate, using insights to help inform and strengthen creative thinking.
REPORTING:
You know how to turn data into a clear story. You understand the metrics and measures of social media and know how to translate volume, sentiment, themes, and performance data into meaningful takeaways. You can clearly articulate what’s happening, why it matters, and what the team should consider or watch next.
EXPERIENCE & SKILLS
4+ years relevant experience working in a related role or capacity. You have experience in digital/social media with a proven track record of insights that have turned into responsive content or PR-planned ideas.
Extensive knowledge and work experience in social media, with experience across all the major platforms (Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, as well as Pinterest)
You’re culturally connected – with a keen sense of what’s going on in online culture.

You’re technologically savvy, with an understanding of the tools used to mine insights and monitor social performance.

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?
Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.
About GDFT
Gaming, Developer, and Future Technology (GDFT) are the technology specialists at PlayStation. We build the underlying systems that power core platform capabilities and developer tools. Our mission is to enable world-class gaming experiences by delivering low-level, high-performance technology for PlayStation platforms.
The Role
We are looking for an engineer to join the GDFT department, working on the design and optimisation of PlayStation’s real-time game streaming technologies.
You will contribute to the development of low-latency video streaming systems across current and future PlayStation platforms, working on performance-critical areas spanning frame capture, media pipelines, codec configuration, system services and streaming transport.
The role is particularly suited to engineers with a strong C/C++ background and experience working with native video or media systems, including embedded devices, TV firmware, set-top boxes, consoles, or similar.
Our work sits at the intersection of product engineering and R&D. Alongside delivering production technology, engineers are encouraged to investigate new approaches to reducing end-to-end latency, improving visual quality and reducing bitrate, using measurement and experimentation to determine where meaningful improvements can be made.
What You'll Be Doing
Develop, optimise and maintain low-level C and C++ components within PlayStation’s game streaming stack.
Investigate opportunities to reduce end-to-end streaming latency across frame capture, buffering, encoding, transport, decoding and presentation.
Optimise the use and configuration of hardware video encoders, applying knowledge of codec behaviour and low-latency encoding techniques.
Analyse existing media pipelines to identify unnecessary buffering, memory copies, synchronisation delays and other sources of latency.
Use software and hardware instrumentation to measure system behaviour, validate hypotheses and quantify the impact of performance changes.
Investigate and debug issues across user-space applications, system services and daemon-level components.
Prototype and evaluate new approaches to improving streaming quality, latency and bandwidth efficiency.
Work with engineers and researchers across the wider organisation on areas such as codec development, rate control, Forward Error Correction and emerging media technologies.
Contribute technical findings and recommendations to design discussions, working with senior engineers to determine appropriate production solutions.
Collaborate across teams to integrate and validate streaming technologies within PlayStation platform software.
Attend periodic in-person workshops or team events, with travel possible a few times per year.
What We Are Looking For
This is a mid-level opportunity. You should bring some of the following skills and experience:
Strong proficiency in C and C++.
Experience developing native, performance-sensitive software rather than primarily web or managed application stacks.
Experience working with real-time video, media pipelines, codecs or embedded multimedia systems.
Practical understanding of video compression and media formats, including concepts such as chroma subsampling, bit depth and colour representation, with familiarity of codecs such as AVC, HEVC or AV1.
Understanding of concepts relevant to low-latency video encoding, which may include GOP structures, reference frames, rate control, VBV, quantisation parameters, slices, tiles or hardware codec APIs.
Strong debugging, profiling and performance-analysis skills.
An ability to investigate complex technical problems, identify likely causes and use evidence and instrumentation to support conclusions.
Comfortable working in unfamiliar parts of a large system and developing an understanding of how multiple components interact.
An experimental mindset, with an interest in prototyping, measuring and evaluating alternative technical approaches.
Ability to contribute to technical discussions and work with senior engineers when deciding how findings should be taken forward.
Highly Desirable Skills:
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be advantageous; we do not expect candidates to have experience across all of them:
Familiarity with techniques for evaluating video codec performance, including bitrate/quality/latency trade-offs and objective or perceptual video quality metrics (such as PSNR and VMAF).
Familiarity with compressed video bitstreams and codec signalling, such as NAL units/OBUs, parameter sets, profiles/levels and supplemental enhancement information.
Experience developing native video players, media frameworks or codec pipelines on TVs, set-top boxes, consoles, mobile devices or other embedded platforms.
Experience configuring or integrating hardware video encoders or decoders.
Deeper knowledge of H.264, HEVC, AV1 or other current and emerging video codecs, beyond high-level API configuration, such as reference structures, rate-control behaviour, bitstream structure or encoder-specific optimisation.
Experience optimising real-time video for low latency, visual quality or bitrate efficiency.
Familiarity with frame capture, graphics presentation pipelines, framebuffers or GPU/CPU synchronisation.
Experience identifying and reducing memory copies, queueing delays, memory-bandwidth limitations or other system-level performance bottlenecks.
Experience working with system services, daemons, firmware interfaces or other low-level platform components.
Familiarity with techniques such as content-aware encoding, region-of-interest encoding, adaptive resolution or frame rate, alternative reference-frame strategies or similar streaming optimisations.
Experience with Forward Error Correction or other techniques for improving the resilience of real-time media.
Experience with SIMD, vectorisation, cache optimisation or multithreaded performance tuning with instrumentation.
Experience with console or embedded systems development environments.
Experience with Git, Jenkins or similar CI/CD workflows.
Why Work in GDFT
Focused on platform-wide technology development
Room to explore and innovate within performance-critical system areas
Work on cross-regional collaborative projects
Flexible and relaxed working environment, with strong support for hybrid work
Opportunities for extensive professional development, technical conference attendance, and participation in internal hackathons

jobs.description: Job Details: Job Description: What if you could help define how developers program an entirely new class of AI hardware? For nearly a decade, Intel's Neuromorphic Computing Lab, together with a global ecosystem of more than 250 research groups, has advanced architectures, algorithms, and software inspired by the brain's remarkable efficiency, scalability, and adaptability. Our Loihi research chips pioneered event-driven, sparse, and massively parallel neuro-inspired computing, contributing to more than 100 peer-reviewed publications and establishing the potential of this new approach. Now we are taking the next step: transforming those breakthroughs into technologies for physical AI systems, such as robots and intelligent edge devices that must sense, decide, and act under tight latency and power constraints. This is an opportunity to join at a formative stage and help create the kernels, programming abstractions, and performance models for a new hardware architecture built around sparse, event-driven, and massively parallel computation. Your work will directly influence both the hardware and how developers use it. You will also help shape a software stack designed for an era in which engineers and AI agents build and optimize applications together. Position Overview As an AI Software Engineer in Neuromorphic Computing, you will turn new neuromorphic hardware capabilities into working, high-performance AI software and contribute to critical technical areas from design through delivery. You will build specialized kernels for current and next-generation neuromorphic hardware, explore optimization strategies that conventional processors cannot offer, and help shape the programming abstractions that expose those capabilities to developers. Working alongside hardware architects, compiler engineers, and AI researchers, you will use performance and power models to influence design decisions before silicon is available and then validate those decisions using simulators, emulators, and hardware. Your work will span the full hardware-software lifecycle, from modeling a hardware feature to implementing the kernel that unlocks it and demonstrating measurable gains on real AI workloads. You will contribute to the training, porting, and optimization of end-to-end applications for Loihi-based systems while helping improve engineering quality across the team. As part of Intel's CTO Office, you will join a vertically integrated incubation effort dedicated to bringing Intel's neuromorphic technology innovations to market. Our diverse team of engineers and researchers has pioneered sparse, event-based neuromorphic architectures across multiple generations and is now focused on commercializing the technology in future Intel and partner products. The primary responsibilities for this role will include, but are not limited to: Design and implement specialized AI kernels for neuromorphic hardware using custom DSLs and accelerator programming models such as CUDA and SYCL and help shape the programming abstractions for Intel's next-generation neuromorphic architecture. Develop and optimize operations for convolutional networks, transformers, and generative AI workloads by applying techniques such as tiling, fusion, vectorization, parallelization, layout transformation, buffering, sparsity, and quantization. Develop performance methodologies and improve kernel behavior in areas such as compute utilization, latency, throughput, memory bandwidth, data movement, synchronization, and scaling, turning architectural insights into measurable workload gains. Build reference models, numerical validation tools, benchmarks, and analytical or simulation-based performance, power, and area models that guide hardware-software co-design; reconcile discrepancies across models, simulators, emulators, and hardware. Collaborate with hardware, compiler, runtime, and application engineers to deliver maintainable code, tests, documentation, benchmarks, and performance-regression infrastructure. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
쿠팡 및 쿠팡 계열사에서는 Finance 관점에서 Business Partner 역할을 하는 FP&A(재무분석/기획) 담당자를 찾고 있습니다. 빠르게 성장하는 비즈니스의 경쟁력을 강화할 수 있는 재무전략에 대한 경험, 뛰어난 분석 역량을 갖추신 분들을 찾습니다. Financial Modeling 경험은 필수로, Corporate Finance 경력 없으신 IB/회계법인 출신 분들도 환영합니다.
